protocol.observerControl: Write raw samples in Git-ignored staging; publish once the selected axes complete; launch children through process.execPath
protocol.capacity: worst of two round frame p95; thresholds 16.7 and 33.3 ms
protocol.maximum: largest measured passing load; no interpolation
protocol.numericGateRule: After an optimized visible-water point: numeric step >=15% of median frame, CPU dominance in aggregate and both rounds; stop without a prototype
protocol.safety: Larger waters require the 4 GiB memory reserve below; stop at an FPS/resource bound or 8192 waters
protocol.initialSafety: Initial guard 512; larger waters require a 4 GiB RAM reserve; stop at an FPS/resource bound or 8192 waters

waterMemorySafety.rule: Beyond 512, require previous measured maximum renderer VmHWM scaled by count to fit available memory minus the reserve; stop as resource-bound otherwise
